outcome: Give head of payments / chief risk officer a governed method to improve intraday liquidity forecast error using nostro balances, settlement schedules and trade flows, with final decisions retained…
overview: Treasury Liquidity Intraday Forecasting addresses teams rely on lagging aggregates when forecasts or decisions depend on changing operational conditions in banking and payments operations. The first proof of value uses nostro balances, settlement schedules and trade flows. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is intraday liquidity forecast error, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: nostro balances, settlement schedules and trade flows; define intraday liquidity forecast error and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of Payments / Chief Risk Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including backtest across seasonal and peak periods with a holdout cohort.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
